title: User Interface Consistency
definition: The coherence and logical flow of elements in a user interface, ensuring clarity and ease of use.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine you're reading a book, and every time you turn the page, the color of the text changes. That's confusing and hard to follow. A good user interface keeps things consistent, making it easy for users to understand and navigate.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: User interface consistency refers to the use of a consistent design style for elements and components in a user interface. This ensures that the layout and appearance of the application are coherent and predictable, making it easier for users to understand and navigate.
difficulty_levels.expert: User interface consistency is a critical aspect of human-computer interaction. It not only improves usability and accessibility but also contributes to brand identity. Inconsistencies can lead to confusion, frustration, and loss of trust. A consistent design language ensures that the user experience is seamless across different screens and platforms, reflecting a unified vision and philosophy.

extra_fields.insight: The text color in the user interface should be consistent for all links and buttons.
